selection_rule: representative section-consistency panel requires direction-consistent size effect, all 3 sections represented, and >=20 cells in every section
measurement_boundary: area is the current segmentation-derived 3D voxel-count proxy; distributions are section-normalized before cross-type comparison. Point size in the black spatial panel is display-only within-section area percentile.
principle: Show distribution and tissue context first; effect sizes annotate rather than replace the biological data.
